title: Natural Science and Environmental Problems
description: An introduction to environmental systems and contemporary environmental problems, with attention to scientific evidence, policy responses, and human impacts.

title: Sustainability and Data Science Tools
description: A graduate seminar introducing data-driven tools for sustainability research, assessment, visualization, communication, and decision-making.

title: Research Mentoring
description: Individual and team-based training in research design, policy analysis, geospatial methods, environmental sensing, data analysis, and scholarly communication.
